hero.title: Cameroon, seen slowly
hero.subtitle: Rainforest to Sahel, fishing coast to volcanic peak — we build small-group journeys through Cameroon's ten regions, guided by the people who call them home.

regionStrip.title: Four countries in one
regionStrip.coastDesc: Black-sand beaches, fishing villages, Limbe & Kribi
regionStrip.rainforestDesc: Dja Reserve, Korup, forest trails and waterfalls
regionStrip.savannaDesc: Waza safaris, Rhumsiki peaks, Mandara mountains
regionStrip.highlandsDesc: Bamileke chiefdoms, crater lakes, tea country

home.toursTitle: Built around a region, not a checklist
home.toursSubtitle: Every itinerary below pairs a landscape with the people and food that define it. Mix, extend, or shorten any of them — this is a starting point, not a package.
home.cultureSubtitle: From the Sultan's palace at Foumban to the Ngondo festival on the Wouri River, Cameroon's diversity is its main attraction. We travel with local hosts, not past them.
home.foodTitle: Eat your way through the regions
home.foodSubtitle: Ndolé by the coast, achu in the Grassfields, suya smoke over Yaoundé evenings — food is on the itinerary, not an afterthought.
home.whyTitle: Small groups, local partners, honest pricing
home.why1Desc: Every trip is led by a guide who grew up where you're visiting — not a national guide reading from notes.
home.why2Desc: Small enough to eat at a family table, stay in a village guesthouse, and change plans when something better comes up.
home.why3Desc: Every rate is shown in US dollars and Russian roubles, updated regularly, with nothing hidden until checkout.
home.ctaTitle: Tell us what you want to see
home.ctaSubtitle: Send a few lines about your dates, interests and group size — we'll reply within a day with a route built around them.
home.beyondTitle: A pan-African agency, Cameroon at heart
home.beyondSubtitle: We started in Cameroon and know it best — but the same small-group, locally-guided approach now reaches a handful of other African countries too.

toursPage.title: Every route we run
toursPage.subtitle: Fixed departures and private itineraries across the coast, the rainforest, the Sahel and the western highlands.

culturePage.title: Culture, region by region
culturePage.subtitle: Cameroon is often called “Africa in miniature” for its landscapes — the same is true of its cultures. Here's a starting point for what you'll encounter.

foodPage.title: A short menu of Cameroon
foodPage.subtitle: We build a meal or a market visit into every itinerary. These are the dishes worth arriving hungry for.

aboutPage.title: A Douala-based team, ten years on the road
aboutPage.p1: We started as three friends taking visiting friends around Mount Cameroon and the Kribi coastline. A decade later we're a small agency based in Douala, working with drivers, guesthouses and guides across all ten regions.
aboutPage.p2: We keep groups small on purpose. It means slower mornings, meals at family tables instead of tour-bus car parks, and itineraries that can bend when a festival, a fishing trip or a rainstorm changes the plan.
aboutPage.p3: Every guide on our team is from the region they guide in. We think that's the difference between visiting a place and being shown it.
aboutPage.value1Desc: Guides, drivers, cooks and guesthouses are hired from the communities we visit.
aboutPage.value2Desc: Most groups run 4 to 10 travellers so we can stay flexible and low-impact.
aboutPage.value3Desc: Quoted in dollars and roubles, with what's included spelled out before you book.

servicesPage.title: Everything else a trip to Cameroon needs
servicesPage.subtitle: Visas, hotels, cars, and short or long-term rentals — arranged by the same team that plans your itinerary, not outsourced to a call centre.
servicesPage.visaDesc: Document checklists, application support, and appointment scheduling for Cameroon entry visas — tailored to your nationality and travel dates.
servicesPage.hotelsDesc: From beach lodges in Kribi to city hotels in Douala and Yaoundé, we book stays that match your itinerary and budget — not just what ranks highest online.
servicesPage.carsDesc: Self-drive or with a driver, 4x4s for the north or sedans for city travel — arranged with vetted local partners, insurance included.
servicesPage.carsPoint2: 4x4 options for Sahel and mountain routes
servicesPage.rentalsDesc: Furnished apartments in Douala and Yaoundé for longer stays — relocation, remote work, or extended family visits — with local move-in support.
servicesPage.rentalsPoint2: Verified listings, no surprises on arrival
servicesPage.rentalsPoint3: Local support for move-in and utilities

studyRussiaPage.title: Study in Russia, with real support at every step
studyRussiaPage.subtitle: We accompany African students from application to arrival and throughout their studies — the same door-to-door care we bring to a trip, applied to a much bigger journey.
studyRussiaPage.why1Desc: Russian universities offer internationally recognised degrees in medicine, engineering, and the sciences, at a fraction of Western tuition costs.
studyRussiaPage.why2Desc: Decades of African students in Russian university cities mean established communities, mentors, and support networks already in place.
studyRussiaPage.why3Desc: We don't stop at admission — our team stays in contact through the school year, not just the first month.
studyRussiaPage.included1: University and programme selection based on your goals and budget
studyRussiaPage.included3: Student visa support and embassy appointment scheduling
studyRussiaPage.included4: Airport pickup and help settling into student housing
studyRussiaPage.included5: A local contact throughout the academic year for questions or problems
studyRussiaPage.step1Desc: We discuss your field of interest, budget, and target start date, and shortlist realistic universities and programmes.
studyRussiaPage.step2Desc: We help prepare and submit your documents, and follow up with the university on your behalf.
studyRussiaPage.step3Desc: Once accepted, we guide you through the student visa process and book your travel.
studyRussiaPage.step4Desc: Someone from our network meets you at the airport and helps you settle into housing in your first week.
studyRussiaPage.step5Desc: We stay reachable throughout the year — for renewals, questions, or just a familiar voice in a new country.
studyRussiaPage.ctaSubtitle: Tell us your field of interest and target year — we'll reply with realistic university options and next steps.
